units.source_text: 父亲的精神越来越衰弱了，曾经让我吃惊的那个后面系着手帕的旧草帽也自然而然地被闲置了。

en.t: Father's spirits grew weaker and weaker, and the old straw hat with the handkerchief tied at the back, which had once startled me, naturally fell into disuse.

units.source_text: 每当我看见那个放在熏黑的搁板上的草帽时，便觉得父亲很可怜。

en.t: Whenever I saw that straw hat on the smoke-blackened shelf, I felt sorry for my father.

units.source_text: 父亲像以前那样下地走动的时候，我就很担心，觉得他应该再小心一些才好，

en.t: When my father went out and moved around as he had before, I worried and thought he ought to be a little more careful,

units.source_text: 父亲总是坐着不动时，我又觉得他的身体毕竟不如从前了。

en.t: But when he sat still all the time, I felt again that his body was, after all, no longer what it had been.

units.source_text: 我常常跟母亲谈起父亲的身体。

en.t: I often talked with my mother about Father's health.

units.source_text: “都是心理作用。”母亲说。

en.t: It is all in the mind, Mother said.

units.source_text: 母亲总是把天皇陛下的病和父亲的病联系在一起考虑，我可不这么看。

en.t: Mother always linked His Majesty the Emperor's illness with Father's, but I did not see it that way.

units.source_text: “不是心理作用。

en.t: It is not in the mind.

units.source_text: 真的身体没有问题吗？

en.t: Is there really nothing wrong with his body?

units.source_text: 我总觉得心情还不是问题，而是身体越来越坏了。”

en.t: I feel it is not his mood that is the problem, but that his body is getting worse and worse.

units.source_text: 我这样说着，心里考虑要不要从远处请一位高明的医生来给父亲检查一下。

en.t: Saying this, I wondered inwardly whether I should call in a capable doctor from far away to examine Father.

units.source_text: “今年夏天，你也过得挺没意思的吧。

en.t: This summer has been rather dull for you too, hasn't it?

units.source_text: 好不容易毕了业，我们也没能给你庆贺庆贺，

en.t: You finally graduated, but we have not even been able to celebrate for you,

units.source_text: 你爸的身子这样糟糕，又赶上天子患病。

en.t: With your father in such poor health and then the Emperor falling ill.

units.source_text: 你一回来就请客倒好了。”

en.t: It would have been better if we had invited guests as soon as you came home.

units.source_text: 我到家是七月五六日，

en.t: I came home around July fifth or sixth,

units.source_text: 父母提出为庆贺我毕业请客，是我到家一星期之后。

en.t: It was a week after I arrived that my parents proposed inviting guests to celebrate my graduation.

units.source_text: 然后又过了一个多星期，才好歹定下了日子。

en.t: Then more than another week passed before we finally managed to settle on a date.

units.source_text: 回到不受时间约束的悠闲的乡村之后，

en.t: After returning to the leisurely countryside, unconstrained by time,

units.source_text: 我才终于从令人厌烦的社交痛苦中解脱出来。

en.t: I was at last freed from the tiresome pain of social obligations.

units.source_text: 但是，不了解我的母亲，似乎根本没有发现这一点。

en.t: But my mother, who did not understand me, seemed not to have noticed this at all.
